data.body: Correction: the immediately prior test-contract entry was shell-mangled by Markdown command substitution; ignore its production-path fragment. Authoritative contract: signed story 1934 ACs. Preconditions: fresh ticket with default empty impact, then real CLI/library/MCP writes. Production paths: worktree Python CLI through argv registry and leaf FILE_IMPACT reducer; public rebar API through the same leaf; FastMCP through public API; JSON Schema validation. Test tiers: reducer transition unit, real CLI subprocess/library integration, in-process FastMCP contract. Exact postconditions: kind/reason/paths, persisted show state, exit 2 plus stable error and no event for invalid input, old array output unchanged. Negative controls: undeclared default and legacy JSON-array form. Invalid writes leave state unchanged; paths clears reason; none clears paths. Reason input is untrusted and must be validated once at the shared write seam without shell evaluation.
